name: Hotel Park
beschreibung: The Hotel Park in Tirol is located in a quiet side location, yet close to the center, and offers a good starting point for activities in the region. The architecture combines Alpine tradition with modern lines. The rooms are contemporary and have a balcony as well as free Wi-Fi. The breakfast buffet is extensive; dinner is often offered as a buffet or menu with regional dishes. In the wellness area, a sauna, steam bath, and a relaxation room are available. In the surrounding area, guests can hike or mountain bike in summer, while in winter the nearby ski areas are used. A paid parking lot and a garage are available on site. The Hotel Park thus appeals to both vacation guests and business travelers looking for functional and quiet accommodation.
